episode.title: Make recursive chat-history compaction use non-mutating head selection and accurate tail accounting
episode.before: At parent dc2d7b1dfe76b46a371e897aff76c3af76c73dd0, ChatSummary.summarize_real split oversized history into a head and preserved tail, truncated the head to the summarizer model's input allowance by reversing both the head messages and their token tuples, and then reversed the retained messages again before summarization. It subsequently attempted to calculate tail_tokens from sized[split_index:] after sized had already been replaced by sized[:split_index], so that slice was empty and the preserved tail contributed zero to the decision whether another compaction pass was required.
episode.after: At 188e9e1114f0dfdeb95f9b1592bc81777a8226fa, summarize_real keeps the original tokenization intact, creates sized_head for the head, accumulates head messages directly without in-place reversal, and computes tail_tokens from the untouched sized list. It returns summary plus tail only when their measured tokens fit max_tokens; otherwise it recursively compacts that combined result with an incremented depth.
episode.diff: The single-file change in aider/history.py replaces mutation and reversal of head/sized with a sized_head iteration, retains the existing model-input fallback and 512-token reserve, moves tail-token calculation to the original sized sequence, and constructs summary + tail only at the return or recursive call. No tests were added or modified in the pinned commit.

evidence_units.claim: Commit 188e9e1114f0dfdeb95f9b1592bc81777a8226fa is titled "Optimize head-truncation loop in `summarize_real`", has parent dc2d7b1dfe76b46a371e897aff76c3af76c73dd0, and modifies only aider/history.py.
evidence_units.source: git show --stat --format=fuller 188e9e1114f0dfdeb95f9b1592bc81777a8226fa; issue-bundle.json linked_pull_requests[0].commits and files

evidence_units.claim: In the parent implementation, summarize_real assigns sized = sized[:split_index], reverses head and sized, selects messages under model_max_input_tokens, and reverses keep before calling summarize_all.
In the parent implementation, tail_tokens is calculated with sum(... for ... in sized[split_index:]) after sized was truncated to sized[:split_index], making the measured tail slice empty.

The change introduces sized_head = sized[:split_index] and iterates its (tokens, msg) pairs directly, eliminating the in-place reversal of message and token lists while retaining the model maximum-input fallback and 512-token reserve.

The change computes tail_tokens from the untouched sized[split_index:] and uses summary_tokens + tail_tokens to choose between returning summary + tail and recursively compacting summary + tail at depth + 1.
Application startup constructs ChatSummary from the weak and main models and a configured or model-default chat-history token budget, making summarize_real part of runtime context-budget enforcement.
evidence_units.source: git show 188e9e1114f0dfdeb95f9b1592bc81777a8226fa:aider/main.py, ChatSummary construction near main startup

evidence_units.claim: Coder initialization also constructs ChatSummary with the weak and main models and main_model.max_chat_history_tokens; coder transitions separately call summarize_all when an edit-format change requires condensing prior messages.
evidence_units.source: git show 188e9e1114f0dfdeb95f9b1592bc81777a8226fa:aider/coders/base_coder.py, Coder initialization and from_coder transition logic

evidence_units.claim: The pinned test module covers tokenization, oversized-history summarization, summary production, and fallback to a second model, but contains no assertion identifying exactly which head messages are passed to summarize_all or explicitly exercising nonempty tail-token accounting.
The focused pinned test module completed successfully in an isolated archive of the implementation commit.

The pinned implementation retains existing guards: histories within max_tokens are returned unchanged at depth zero; histories of four or fewer messages or recursion depth above three are summarized as a whole; and the tail split is aligned so the head ends with an assistant message.

candidate_atomics.name: select-head-within-summarizer-input-budget
candidate_atomics.description: Select a bounded subset of the compactable history head using its precomputed token sizes, without mutating the full history tokenization needed by later budget checks.

semantic_action.intent: Keep the input sent to the summarization model within its available input context while preserving token-accounting data for the complete history split.
semantic_action.pre_state: An oversized message history has been split into a compactable head and a recent tail, with per-message token sizes available and a summarizer input limit that may be undefined.
semantic_action.post_state: A sequence of head messages whose cumulative measured size does not exceed the summarizer input allowance minus the safety reserve is available for summarization, while the original full tokenization remains intact.
semantic_action.validation: Inspect the selected sequence passed to the head summarizer and verify its accumulated token count respects the model input allowance; the existing focused tests establish only broad integration success, not exact selection semantics.

candidate_atomics.name: reconcile-summary-and-tail-against-output-budget
candidate_atomics.description: Measure the generated summary together with the preserved tail and recurse only when their combined size remains above the configured history budget.

semantic_action.intent: Prevent a compacted history from being accepted based on an incomplete token total that omits the preserved recent tail.
semantic_action.pre_state: A compactable head has been summarized, a recent tail must be preserved, and both summary and tail token sizes can be measured.
semantic_action.post_state: The summary and tail are returned only when their combined measured size is below the configured history budget; otherwise their combination enters another bounded compaction pass.
semantic_action.validation: Verify tail tokens are computed from the intact full tokenization and that the return/recursion branch compares summary_tokens plus tail_tokens with max_tokens; the pinned focused test module exits successfully.

candidate_workflows.name: compact-oversized-history-with-complete-budget-accounting
candidate_workflows.description: For an oversized conversational history, preserve a recent tail, bound the older material sent to the summarizer, then account for both the generated summary and preserved tail before accepting the compacted result or recursing.

workflow_graph.goal: Produce a compacted chat history that respects both the summarizer's input capacity and the configured retained-history budget without losing the recent tail from budget accounting.
workflow_graph.entry_state: A runtime chat history exceeds its configured token budget and contains enough messages to split an older head from a recent tail.
workflow_graph.exit_state: The older head has been summarized from a bounded input and the returned summary-plus-tail fits the configured history budget, or established depth/size guards have reduced the entire remaining history through whole-history summarization.
unresolved_or_deferred: The pinned tests do not provide a targeted oracle for which portion of the head should be retained when it exceeds the summarizer input limit.
No test added by the change directly demonstrates that a nonempty tail triggers recursion when summary plus tail exceeds max_tokens.
Cross-project pattern induction and holdout promotion are deferred because this episode supplies only one repository workflow.

unresolved_questions: The parent selected a suffix of the head by reversing it before truncation, whereas the pinned implementation iterates sized_head in original order and therefore selects a prefix. The available issue bundle has no body or review discussion, and the tests do not establish whether this behavioral change was intentional.
The focused test suite passed, but no commit-specific regression test proves exact head-selection ordering or the corrected tail-budget branch.
